causalGroups.name: Git commands
causalGroups.blocker: @emulsify/cli 2.4.1 requires simple-git ^3.36.0; registry latest simple-git 4.0.2 uses patched @simple-git/argv-parser 2.0.1. CLI needs an upstream release accepting the fixed major or a compatible backport.

causalGroups.name: Browser archive extraction
causalGroups.blocker: extract-zip latest 2.0.1 has no patched release for either recorded advisory. A compatible extract-zip fix or an upstream @puppeteer/browsers/Puppeteer/Pa11y/Core dependency migration is needed.

causalGroups.name: Browser proxy FTP support
causalGroups.blocker: basic-ftp is fixed in 6.2.1 and latest is 6.2.3, but installed get-uri 6.0.5 requires ^5.0.2. An upstream get-uri/proxy/browser update accepting the fixed major, or a compatible 5.x backport, is needed.

causalGroups.name: Lint glob patterns
causalGroups.blocker: braces latest 3.0.3 remains affected and has no patched release. A braces fix or upstream micromatch/glob/Stylelint migration is needed.

causalGroups.name: Jest coverage configuration
causalGroups.blocker: sprintf-js latest 1.1.3 remains affected. A compatible sprintf-js fix or an upstream @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config release replacing its js-yaml 3 -> argparse 1 -> sprintf-js chain is needed.
